+package game
+
+import "testing"
+
+// TestDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn_NoControllerRestriction exercises the
+// target_filter_dealt_damage_this_turn primitive (ticket
+// engine.auto-target-filter-dealt-damage-this-turn-7541e11849, Ogre
+// Siegebreaker class): "Destroy target creature that was dealt damage this
+// turn." Unlike the pre-existing Manticore-class filter
+// ("creature_dealt_damage_this_turn_opp_ctrl"), Ogre Siegebreaker's filter
+// carries no controller restriction at all. This confirms
+// executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn composes correctly with the bare
+// "creature_dealt_damage_this_turn" bucket (no _opp_ctrl/_you_ctrl suffix)
+// already handled generically by matchesPermanentFilter/matchesPermanentFilterCtl
+// — no new engine wiring required.
+func TestDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn_NoControllerRestriction(t *testing.T) {
+	gs := NewGame("P0", "P1", false)
+
+	damaged := NewCreature("Damaged Beast", ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
+	damaged.Owner, damaged.Controller = 1, 1
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(damaged)
+	damaged.DealDamage(1)
+
+	undamaged := NewCreature("Undamaged Beast", ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
+	undamaged.Owner, undamaged.Controller = 1, 1
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(undamaged)
+
+	// Never itself received damage — Card.Damage is a recipient-only
+	// counter, so a creature that only DEALT damage this turn (the
+	// dealer-side negative example) still reads Damage == 0 here and must
+	// not be selected by a recipient-scoped filter.
+	dealer := NewCreature("Damage Dealer", ManaCost{}, 2, 2, 1)
+	dealer.Owner, dealer.Controller = 0, 0
+	gs.Battlefield.AddCard(dealer)
+
+	filter := "creature_dealt_damage_this_turn"
+
+	// The damaged creature is destroyed, independent of its controller
+	// and independent of damage amount/source.
+	if err := gs.executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn(
+		[]Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: damaged.ID}}, filter, 0); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn: %v", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(damaged.ID); err == nil {
+		t.Fatalf("expected damaged creature to be destroyed and removed from the battlefield")
+	}
+
+	// An undamaged creature is not a legal target and is skipped, not destroyed.
+	if err := gs.executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn(
+		[]Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: undamaged.ID}}, filter, 0); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn: %v", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(undamaged.ID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("expected undamaged creature to remain on the battlefield, got removed")
+	}
+
+	// A creature that dealt damage this turn but was never itself dealt
+	// damage (dealer-side reading) is also not a legal target.
+	if err := gs.executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn(
+		[]Target{{IsCard: true, CardID: dealer.ID}}, filter, 0); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("executeDestroyTargetDealtDamageThisTurn: %v", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := gs.Battlefield.GetCard(dealer.ID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("expected damage-dealing (not damaged) creature to remain on the battlefield, got removed")
+	}
+}
